books.title: Books
books.intro: Books read aloud from e-book catalogs (OPDS), such as Standard Ebooks or your own library server. Add the catalogs here; the books in them can then be asked for by title or author.
books.catalogs.title: Catalogs
books.ask: Say "read me the book …" or "read my books" to hear one.

books.none: No catalogs. Add one to have books to read.
